layout_and_spacing.grid: Control Room grid for Dashboard (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), gap-4 or gap-6
layout_and_spacing.padding: Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8 internal padding
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows (e.g., shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md hover)

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), slight lift (-translate-y-1) on hover with shadow-lg. Do not overuse.
components.buttons: Primary buttons use #006400 bg with white text. Hover state: bg-[#004d00] text-white. Use rounded-xl or rounded-full.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults with custom focus ring (focus:ring-[#006400]/20). Left-aligned labels.
components.navigation: Bottom tab bar for mobile, Sidebar or Top Navbar with backdrop-blur-xl (Glassmorphism) for desktop.
components.charts: Shadcn Recharts components. Use #006400 for income, #ef4444 for expenses, #FFD700 for taxes.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have hover and focus states (higher contrast).
motion_and_interactions.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, and key informational elements (e.g., data-testid='link-bank-button', data-testid='tax-health-score').

avatars.description: User Avatar - Nigerian business owner profile picture

specific_features.tax_health_score: Render as a circular progress chart or prominent gauge. Colors: #006400 (80-100), #FFD700 (50-79), #ef4444 (0-49).
specific_features.pidgin_toggle: Small switch in the navigation header or settings. Label 'Pidgin / EN'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this JSON strictly. Map colors to Tailwind arbitrary values where necessary (e.g., bg-[#006400]).
Ensure all text has a minimum WCAG AA contrast ratio against its background.
Implement Shadcn UI for complex inputs like dropdowns, date pickers, tables, and dialogs. Do NOT use HTML `<select>`.
Create a responsive, mobile-first dashboard following the 'Control Room' grid strategy.
MANDATORY: Include `data-testid` on all interactive and functional elements.
Focus on building a friendly and non-intimidating user experience that simplifies Nigerian tax laws.
